title: kw_bytes assigned but only used to suppress warning
description: posting.rs:212,231. In keyword_matches(), the variable kw_bytes is assigned on line 212 (let kw_bytes = lower_keyword.as_bytes()) but is never used in the function body. Line 231 has 'let _ = kw_bytes; // suppress unused warning' — a workaround that should be removed by simply not assigning the variable.
